attribution.scope: The profile and fixtures are a new standalone standards contribution. This attribution records conceptual provenance and does not assert exclusive ownership, maintainer acceptance, runtime authority, or copied proprietary implementation.

fixture_key_provenance: Four synthetic Ed25519 test keypairs were generated offline once in memory to produce the pinned signatures. Only public DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo keys and static signatures are retained; private components were not written to disk. Regeneration uses no key generation, private key, seed, random input, or network.

subject.provenance: TEST ONLY: synthetic public trust root generated offline for this conformance fixture; not a production identity, authority, observer, or finality root.

vectors.title: Valid authentication with authority evidence absent

coverage.assertion: Authentication is satisfied; authorization is completed but indeterminate because its distinct decision evidence is unavailable.

vectors.title: Same authentication basis with an independently checked authorization decision

coverage.assertion: The distinct governance signature and policy decision satisfy AUTHORIZED; authentication alone does not do so.

vectors.title: Valid authorization without independent enforcement evidence

coverage.assertion: ENFORCED is completed and indeterminate; authorization remains independently satisfied.

vectors.title: Same authorization basis with a checked enforcement observation

coverage.assertion: The signed observer statement is bound to the action, obligation, result identifier, and policy profile.

vectors.title: Recorded and internally consistent outcome without a finality witness

coverage.assertion: The missing independent witness leaves the precise finality proposition indeterminate.

vectors.title: Same recorded outcome with the profile-defined synthetic finality witness

coverage.assertion: The signature proves only the fixture-defined commitment match under the pinned synthetic trust root.

vectors.title: Authentication message tampering with the original signature retained

coverage.assertion: A completed signature check refutes only the exact authentication proposition; it says nothing about whether an event occurred.
The signed material and pinned public fixture key verify.

vectors.title: Completed action commitment recomputation detects a mismatch

coverage.assertion: The mismatch is terminal for the exact binding proposition and blocks every dependent positive claim.
The supplied binding commitment matches the recomputed action commitment.

vectors.title: Completed binding check with the binding commitment unavailable

coverage.assertion: The check completed but is indeterminate, not refuted and not terminal.

vectors.title: Authentication procedure unavailable before its check completed

coverage.assertion: AUTHENTICATED is incomplete plus indeterminate, distinct from a completed indeterminate result.

vectors.title: Enforcement guardrail rewrites the action but retains the prior authorization binding

coverage.assertion: The observer signature is valid, but its effective-action and authorization commitments disagree.

vectors.title: Rewritten action with a newly checked authorization binding

coverage.assertion: The effective action, authorization decision, and independent observation share the corrected commitment.

vectors.title: Independent witness reports a commitment divergent from the recorded outcome

coverage.assertion: Only the finality-match proposition is refuted; OUTCOME_RECORDED remains satisfied and execution is not disproved.

vectors.title: A refuted authentication branch blocks descendants while the outcome branch remains valid

coverage.assertion: AUTHENTICATED is the only local failure; the separately satisfied outcome-record claim remains eligible.
